senses.gloss: m. (קרד; cmp. גְּרִיד) (a pot) covered with a crust formed of hardened sediments.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 76a:14">Ab. Zar. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>האי ק׳ והאי לא ק׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="S02196"><he>קריר</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="C01268"><he>גָּרַד</he></cite> a. <cite ref="C01392"><he>גָּרַר</he></cite>) the one (a vessel taken from gentiles) has crusty accretions, the other (a sacred vessel) has none.
